charts.title: K2-201 b: orbits around K2-201
charts.description: The orbits of K2-201's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-201 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): P 1.059806 d

charts.title: K2-201 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-201 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 125060509, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 176 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 415 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 176 min early; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 138 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
